$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

projection.description: The projection's exact canonical bytes, which are UTF-8 JSON.

WirePrincipal.description:
An opaque principal reference on the wire (spec 020, 3.6): the host's
bytes as lowercase hexadecimal, the host's mapping version, and the
declared scope. Rustev never interprets, authenticates, authorizes or
expands it.

budget_ms.description: The attempt's remaining budget minus the declared transit margin.

descriptor.description: The negotiated descriptor; a different one is `identity_mismatch`.

principal.description:
`rustev.remote/2` only, and only to an endpoint the host operates:
the opaque principal reference (spec 020, 3.6). Routing and isolation
context, never a credential, grant or policy input. Absent otherwise,
so a version 1 request keeps its bytes.

privacy.description: Privacy options requested (3.8.2); never claimed honored.

title: rustev.remote-infer/1 request
